name: 99111 · Colfax, WA
findings: ZIP 99111 (Colfax) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99111 (Colfax) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
70% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
